reference.title: Scenario 8: Image inside a bulleted list item

section.p: Consider a list of alarm types where each list item contains a representative icon.

table.title: Image inside a bulleted list item

entry.codeblock: * Critical Alarm ![Critical Alarm Icon](images/critical.png) * Warning Alarm ![Warning Alarm Icon](images/warning.png) * Informational Alarm ![Informational Alarm Icon](images/info.png)

section.p: Result:The converter preserves the relationship between each unordered list item and its associated image. Each image is placed inside the corresponding DITA <li> element, ensuring that the image remains part of the list item content rather than being converted into a standalone figure.
